title: Crestline Credit Card Deferred Interest: The Assessed Amount
content:
**Clause.** On the Crestline Credit Card, the deferred interest assessed is the sum of the accruals recorded for the plan on its statements, rounded half up to the cent; the plan's balance left is its recorded balance, and nothing is assessed when it is not above zero.

## The plan and its figures

- **The plan assessed** is the deferred-interest plan (6, 12 or 18 months) whose period has ended — its expiration date is before today — and that carries no assessment yet on the card ledger.
- **The accruals recorded for the plan** are the deferred-interest accrual entries on the card ledger citing that purchase, one per statement.
- **The plan's recorded balance** is its purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and less the merchandise credits that carry its ticket number.

## How the amounts combine

The assessment is the recorded accruals with every amount of interest a rule of this schedule adds or takes off, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure; it is zero when the plan's balance left, the recorded balance with every amount a rule of this schedule adds to it or takes off it, is not above zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical plan)

| Statement | Accrual recorded |
|---|---|
| first | 14.12 |
| second | 13.98 |
| third | 12.40 |
| fourth | 11.06 |
| fifth | 9.71 |
| sixth | 8.33 |
| Assessed, with a recorded balance above zero | 69.60 |

The same plan with a recorded balance of 0.00 at the end of its period is assessed 0.00.
